title: Goat and Alpaca Yoga in Arizona
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Specially trained yoga goats interact with you throughout an hour long yoga class. Class is suitable for all ages and abilities!
Napolean and Kip, the Alpacas, will be available for cuddling and pictures. Have you felt an alpaca sweater? Its the softest thing ever! Imagine hugging that fabulous animal!
